overview: Fort Wilderness Resort & Campground has tent and RV campsites in a wooded area on Bay Lake, with trails, horses, campfires and a boat to Magic Kingdom.
suits: Campers and RV travelers, and families who love the outdoors.
rooms: Campsites fit tents or RVs, with water and electric hookups. Full-hookup and premium sites add more space and amenities.
pools: The Meadow Swimmin' Pool is the main pool, with a waterslide.
dining: Trail's End Restaurant serves comfort food, and the Hoop-Dee-Doo Musical Revue is a long-running dinner show.
pros: Lowest-cost way to stay on Disney property for campers
cons: Internal buses or a golf cart are needed to get around
Buses to every park except Magic Kingdom
tips: Rent a golf cart, or bring bikes, to get around the loops.
Catch the free campfire sing-along and outdoor movie in the evening.
bestFor: Campers, RV travelers and outdoor-loving families.
